name: Swift Feather
notes: A floor item (a pale blue feather with a grey shaft). Only the player can pick it up: walking into it plays the item chime, floats '+10% SPEED' over the player and keeps the boost until the run ends. The player walks 10% faster for the rest of the run (topdown_controller speed_var: each point of boost_speed is +10%). It lies at a random one of 9 spots each run (one per screen of the map, all reachable and out from under the tree tops, away from the start, the monsters' homes and the sleeping Alpha); the scene places it at the first.
